news.title: Sacheerome Limited’s Rs 184 crore YEIDA plant awaits certificates - Multibagg AI

guidance: Pratiti Khara: So, we expect the asset turn of around -- so, from just this facility, the asset turn would be around 1.5 to 2x, right, at bare minimum?
Pratiti Khara: So then INR300 crores revenue target is a little on the lower side, right, because we already have the older facilities as well?
capex: One of the most significant development during the period was the commencement of trial production at our new YEIDA facility in September 2026, making an important milestone in our expansion journey.
The installation and commissioning of the facility have been completed during the first half of Financial Year 2027, and trial production commenced in September 2026.
risks: Idea is to start the production and we are under tremendous pressure from our customers to commence the supplies.
And we will -- the kind of response we have, the kind of a pressure, business pressure we have, we will do, we hope to do very well.
focus: I believe this facility will significantly enhance our manufacturing capacity, operational efficiencies, and ability to serve both existing and new customers while providing a strong foundation for our future growth.
The YEIDA facility has been designed as a smart green factory combining advanced manufacturing infrastructure with the focus on operational efficiency and sustainability.
Alongside manufacturing capacity, we will continue to focus on the quality of our formulations, consistency in production and service to provide to our customers.
